note: What each PSI experimental table is allowed to speak to (DESIGN.md section 11). cabin: the table burns or overheats materials found in a cabin. pillars: which of prevention, detection, suppression its rows count for. Each source is a verbatim sentence that goes through the quote gate; a property listed in supports ships only when its sentence passes (cabin falls to false, the pillar is removed). Notes with basis "PSI record" carry no quote: they only restrict.
